description:
The image depicts a serene scene of three umbrellas leaning against a wrought iron fence, set against the backdrop of a rustic stone building with a tiled roof. The arrangement of the umbrellas, each with its unique pattern and color, creates a visually appealing display.

From left to right, the first umbrella features a striking red color, while the second one boasts a classic plaid pattern in shades of brown, white, and black. The third umbrella showcases a vibrant yellow hue with a subtle plaid design
